blocking_findings.finding: The withdrawn runner wrote a PASS-status report before tensor-FD close verification and final source/upstream identity revalidation; interruption or a late failure could leave a standalone PASS artifact.
The withdrawn JSON and event readers hashed one path open and parsed a second path open, so verified bytes and parsed bytes were not guaranteed to be one snapshot.
The withdrawn lock used touch/open with symlink following and formal writes used replaceable paths instead of held non-symlink file descriptors.
If tensor close verification raised, assignment of the verified-close count did not occur and a failure receipt could report zero despite bodies having been read.

checks_that_were_correct_but_do_not_over: left-multiply positive-Y sign and multiplication side
two-batch target-to-cache mapping and 5-to-9 prefix continuity
pixel-shaped tensor rejection before body open
supersession_rule: This is immutable correction history for the withdrawn source set. It is not a PASS review and cannot satisfy the final runner's SOURCE_REVIEW_ADVERSARIAL.json gate.
